verdict.rationale: Kintsugi is a sales tax compliance platform, so a first-party AI that answers taxability and invoice-tax questions is a fair axis. The only AI feature in the evidence is a developer-facing MCP server that reads public docs and the OpenAPI spec to help write integration code. It never touches the API, so it cannot answer taxability or invoice-explanation questions from Kintsugi's rule base with citations. That is an adjacent developer tool, not this capability.

support.subject: As a founder, the product ships its own AI for tax questions — is this product taxable in this state, why did this invoice tax this way — answering from its rule base with citations, not a generic chatbot
